question: What ritual acts of reviving the dead and animating an image are prescribed?
premises: The raising of the dead is prescribed as a ritual act.
The moving of an image is likewise prescribed.
Both acts are to be performed by the practitioner.
inference: The practitioner can accomplish both the revival of the dead and the animation of an image through the prescribed rite.
uncertainties: The exact ritual method for mṛtakotthāpana is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: One should perform the raising of the dead and likewise cause an image to move.
